content: Yakatinihekɨaka 'Iyari kemaine, 'imatɨrieka 'aye'aximekaku, hipatɨ mekatenihayewakuni yuri mete'erietɨ, 'iyarite memɨte'itawa mepɨwa'enieni meta kakaɨyarixi yakɨxeikɨa kememɨte'ɨkita,
mete'ɨkitatɨ yakɨ xeikɨa metekuxatatɨ, Kauyumarie 'inɨarieyakɨ mepɨtepɨatɨarieni yu'iyaritsie, 'ayumieme pɨkawarutate'ani wa'iyari.

Mɨpaɨ mepɨte'aitani memɨkaneneɨkenikɨ memɨkawikiekakɨ meta memɨtehayewanikɨ hipame 'ikwaite metekwatɨ, tsepa Kakaɨyari minetɨa 'ikwaite memenu'ɨnikɨ pamɨpariyutsi me'ipitɨatɨ mɨkɨ yuri memɨte'erie, mɨkɨ tita yuri mɨraine memɨtehetima.
Naime Kakaɨyari mɨtiunetɨa 'aixɨa katini'aneni, tixaɨtɨ pɨkatixani'eriwa xɨka ranupini pamɨpariyutsi 'ipitɨatɨ Kakaɨyari,

Mɨpaɨ xɨka petiwaruta'ɨkitɨani 'iwamarixi, Kɨritsitu Ketsutsi parewiwameya 'aixɨa mɨ'ane pekaniyɨanemɨkɨ, peweretɨ niuki yuri ketemɨte'erie pe'enietɨ, 'ɨkitsika mɨtseɨye pe'enietɨ kepemɨtiweiya 'inɨaritɨme.
Kememɨte'u'ɨxatsita Kakaɨyari meka'ayexeiyatɨ 'ɨxatsi meripaimieme, mɨkɨ kenexani'erieka. Matsi ketine'a'ɨkitɨaka pemɨ'iyamakakɨ Kakaɨyari pemayexeiyanikɨ tɨrɨkaɨyemekɨ.

Xɨka tiyɨ'ɨkitɨaka waiyari mɨ'iyamakakɨ mɨkɨ 'etsiwa pɨtiyunaki'erie, peru xɨka Kakaɨyari 'ayexeiyani, naimekɨ pɨtiyunaki'erie, tukari mexeiyakɨ ketemɨte'utahɨawarie temeixeiyanikɨ hikɨ meta tukari 'umamietsieta.
Mɨkɨ niuki yurikɨ paine meta kaneuyeweka mɨnaki'eriwanikɨ yemekɨ.

Mɨpaɨ mɨ'anekɨ, 'ayumieme tepɨte'uximaya meta 'axatepɨtekɨhɨawarɨwa, yuri temɨte'uta'erikɨ Kakaɨyari mayenieretsie teta'ikwewatɨ, mɨkɨ yunaime teɨteri kaniwawikweitsitɨwametɨni, matsi yemekɨ yuri memɨte'erie.

Xewitɨ pɨkamatsitawe'erieka temaikɨ 'akuxi pemɨhɨkɨkɨ. Matsi mɨkɨ yuri memɨte'erie mɨpaɨ memɨ'anenenikɨ 'inɨari kena'ayeitɨwani kepemɨtiutaniuka, kepemɨtiuyeika, kepemɨti'akanaki'erie, keyapemɨtikamie 'aniukikɨ meta kepemɨti'itiya.
Mexi nekahenuawe, kene'ayumiemetɨni petiterɨwatɨ niuki memɨ'enienikɨ, pewatuikatɨ meta peti'ɨkitatɨ.
Ketineuhayewa pe'itɨmaiyatɨ tita pemɨtiupitɨarie 'iyaritsie timieme, mɨpaɨ pepɨtiupitɨarie tixaxatame tikuxatakaku, kepauka 'ukirawetsixi 'axeikɨa 'ahetsie memutimeixɨa.
Mɨkɨkɨ kene'ayumiemetɨni, mɨkɨtsie keneuyeikani yunaitɨ memɨmatsixeiyakɨ kepemɨraye'axime.
Kene'a'ɨwiyani meta kene'ɨwiyani 'ɨkitsika. Mɨpaɨ petiyurienetɨ kene'ahayewa, mɨkɨkɨ pepɨ'atawikweitsitɨani meta pepɨwatawikweitsitɨani mɨkɨ memɨmatsi'enie.
